name: gelato-mcp
description: Gelato (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, get_order. Every tool maps to a docume

platform_mcp_gelato_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GELATO_API_KEY
platform_mcp_gelato_api_key.description: Gelato API key (dashboard > Developer > API keys), sent as `X-API-KEY`. Product endpoints live on product.gelatoapis.com and are called by absolute URL.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Gelato has no account endpoint; the probe lists the catalogs ([{catalogUid, title}]) with the key, so `account` is empty on success.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: POST /v3/catalogs/{catalogUid}/products:search; `category` is the catalogUid (posters, cards, apparel, ... from GET /v3/catalogs) and is required by this endpoint, `query` is not accepted (attributeFilters are not mapped). Products have no name: `title` is the productUid; attributes, weight and dimensions are in `raw`.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /v3/products/{productUid}: {productUid, attributes, weight, supportedCountries, notSupportedCountries, isStockable, isPrintable, validPageCounts}; `title` is the productUid. Prices per quantity come from GET /v3/products/{productUid}/prices (not mapped).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /v4/orders/{orderId}: {id, orderType, orderReferenceId, fulfillmentStatus, financialStatus, currency, createdAt, items[], shipment{shipmentMethodUid, packages[{trackingCode, trackingUrl}]}, receipts[{totalInclVat}]}; `status` is the fulfillmentStatus (created, passed, printed, shipped, draft, ...), `total` the first receipt's totalInclVat.
